TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR PERMITTED WEAPONS
                                                                                                       VER. 26.2.1

                                                                                   All weights and sizes are in metric (kg and cm)

Bladed Weapons (Sword, Saber, Falchion, etc)                   Weight        Length          Length of the Blade     Length of the Handle                              Special Restrictions

Type 1 Bladed (Arming sword, Falchion, Saber)                 1.1 - 1.7      72 - 100              60 - 80                   12 - 20

Type 2 Bladed (Longsword)                                     1.7 - 2.3      100 - 140             70 - 100                  20 - 50          The Hilt should not extend more then 35mm over the Bearer's hand.

Type 3 Bladed                                                 2.3 - 3.0      120 - 160             90 - 130                  30 - 50


Hafted Weapons (Polearm, Poleaxe, 2-handed axe, etc)           Weight        Length        Length of Striking Edge                            Special Restrictions

Type 1 Hafted (Mace)                                           0.7 -1.3       50-70                  >5

Type 2 Hafted (Axe)                                           0.7 - 1.3       50 - 90                >7              Type 1 Hafted (Maces) must have 6 or more flanges or be a ball. All Hafted weapons with sharp
                                                                                                                     corners (Less than 90 degrees) and corners that can be considered dangerous
                                                                                                                     are not permitted. Any point on the Striking Edge of the weapon Must have an angle more than 90
Type 3 Hafted (Longaxe)                                       1.3 - 2.5      90 - 130                >9              degrees.

Type 4 Hafted (Polearm)                                       2.2 - 3.2      130 - 220              > 12



Outrance Bladed Weapons (Sword, Saber, Falchion, etc)                      Calculation                                                        Special Restrictions

Men                                                                       Balance Point of 15cm or more
                                                                                                                     Outrance swords must also meet the Bladed Weapons Technical Requirements.
                                                                                                                     Balance points are measured from the edge of the grip zone and includes the crossguard.
Women                                                                     Balance Point of 10cm or more


                                                                                         Other Restrictions for all Weapon Types

The permissible upwards error for all weapons is 100g.
Heavier weapons or thrust weapons are not allowed under any circumstance.
The edge of all blades must be rebated and have a thickness of 2mm or more. This applies to striking and non-striking edges of all weapons.
The Radius of all edges must be more than 10mm.
Only Weapons which have chronological validity of a specific historical period as confirmed by the Authenticity Committee are allowed.

                                  Other Restrictions for all Shield and Buckler Types
All shapes must be conform with the "Shields and Bucklers" rule document.
The Radius of striking edge must be more than 7 cm.
Only Shields which have chronological validity of a specific historical period as confirmed by the Authenticity Committee are
allowed.
